translated: When it comes to the lines I deliver as Saki,
this time, since I'm also someone who works in this industry,
there were so many parts where I could really understand Saki-chan's feelings.
As a performer, my perspective on Saki-chan ended up linking with her in so many different ways.
I've been with Saki-chan for a long time now, and because I understand her various emotions,
it was actually quite painful for me as well.
I'd like to introduce another message.
This one is from Sakaguchi-san.
Thank you so much.
Right, these three members.
They said, "Ending the year like this is just too painful!"
Thanks for all the comments, everyone.
And having finished their solo live, their professionalism and the fact they've grown up really shows.
It's true, everyone has shown such incredible growth
along this journey.
Their ways of thinking change, and their emotions move in different ways than before,
which is only natural.
Now, let me read the message from Sakaguchi-san.
"Isobe-san, kon-needo!"
Kon-needo!
"This event story had many scenes of Saki-chan's time in the hospital and her inner conflicts,
making it a very heart-wrenching story to watch.
Especially at the end of Episode 8, when Saki-chan resolved never to reveal her feelings just so she could stay with everyone, I couldn't help but cry."
Thank you for that.
"So my question is, what were you conscious of when performing those painful scenes in Episodes 4 and 8?
I'd also like to know what kind of mindset you had during the recording session.
Isobe-san, you mentioned a little bit about the recording on X..."
